toolbar.startTooltip: Start the selected mode with the configured target.
toolbar.startDisabledInvalidUrl: Fix the URL syntax (scheme is optional — https:// will be assumed).
toolbar.stopTooltip: Stops an active download, path discovery, or region pick.
toolbar.keyboardStartHint: Shortcut: Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) outside text fields.
toolbar.keyboardStopHint: Use Stop to cancel a download, path discovery, or region pick.

sidebar.pickHelp: Opens a browser on this computer. Click a block, use Parent or Child to move up or down the page structure, then Export. HTML, CSS, images, and fonts stay local. Open index.html in the result folder; states.html shows hover, focus, and desktop, tablet, and mobile.
sidebar.captureViewports: Also capture tablet and mobile widths
sidebar.targetUrlHintEmpty: A URL or hostname is required before starting.
sidebar.targetUrlHintInvalid: This does not parse as a valid URL. Include a hostname (https:// optional).
sidebar.pathTxtBundledFallbackDir: If you leave Custom Wordlist empty, path.txt lookups use bundled lists under {{path}}.
sidebar.openOutputFolderTooltip: Opens the resolved download folder in the file manager. Use Serve preview on the toolbar to run local HTTP preview (anydownload-style).
sidebar.liveDownloadActivityIdle: Shows recent resource URLs while a website download runs. Idle when no download task is active.
sidebar.discoveryLiveActivityIdle: Shows recent progress lines while path discovery runs.

dataGrid.noItems: No items to display. Configure and start a task.
dataGrid.resourceFailuresSummary: {{count}} referenced resource(s) failed or were skipped.
dataGrid.cancelledTooltip: This run was cancelled or interrupted.
dataGrid.folderOpenDisabledWhileRunning: Open folder after the task finishes so output layout is stable.
dataGrid.partialSuccessExplain: Task finished but some referenced resources failed. Status is still Success with a skipped count.

statusBar.multiDownloadProgressHintDetail: Shown when multiple website downloads run at once. Percent is averaged for the status strip.
statusBar.averageAcrossDownloads: Average percentage across simultaneous download tasks.
statusBar.liveBytesDisclaimer: Bytes reflect the latest progress event stream (often one active download).
